title: Simple Fast Free
body: Great app, intuitive , always works - love it

title: My Favorite App To Use For Coding Agents
body: I love this app - way better than Termius in my opinion; there is however one small issue where the app has an issue connecting when on a cellular connection. It works flawless on Wi-Fi but on cellular - it struggles to connect via TailScale.

title: Fit my workflow
body: TermRover actually matches how I work from a phone. First-class tmux and Herdr support, access over Tailscale or through an SSH jump host, and a well-designed convenience keyboard, and it is easy to work with coding agents. I like the feature set and I enjoy using the app.

title: Crazy it’s Free
body: Still just exploring the features, but it’s smooth, rich in features, and honestly better than the paid (subscription 🤮) alternatives! I hope he starts charging for this. It’s worth it, I’d pay!
